title: Infrastructure
description: Hosts, storage, services, backups and endpoints. Provisioned from the infra repository

panels.title: Hosts down
panels.description: Hosts whose node exporter can't be scraped

panels.title: Endpoints down
panels.description: Public services failing their probe from freeman

panels.title: Failed units
panels.description: systemd units in the failed state, on all hosts

panels.title: Next certificate expiry
panels.description: Certificates renew 30 days before expiry, so this should stay above 30 days

panels.title: Oldest backup
panels.description: Time since the least recently run backup job started. Backups run daily

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Memory in use by applications. ZFS' ARC cache is counted as available

panels.title: Network traffic
panels.description: Received above the axis, sent below

panels.title: Load average (5m)
panels.description: Compare with the core count in the host summary

panels.title: Filesystem usage
panels.description: Includes the storage box (/mnt/fs-01b) while it is mounted

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: Reads above the axis, writes below

panels.title: Backups: time since last run
panels.description: Each job runs daily. A job that keeps failing also shows up under failed units

panels.title: Availability
panels.description: Probed from freeman every 15 seconds. Redirects and login prompts count as up

panels.title: Certificate expiry
panels.description: Days until expiry. ACME renews at 30 days

panels.title: Server errors (5xx) per service
panels.description: Includes HAProxy's own 502/503 pages when a service is down
